title: Increment, Decrement, and Unary Operators
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of increment, decrement, and unary operators using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates increment, decrement, and unary operators.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Increment, Decrement, and Unary Operators** as part of **Data Types, Operators, and Expressions**. Apply increment, decrement, and unary operators by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—Prefix and Postfix Operators, Unary Plus and Minus, Boolean Negation—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
